name: Ombe
hail: Little Sun, we see you. Share the light with us?
Hello from the round shore, Little Sun. We would like to know you. Would you like to know us?
Little Sun, hello from the shore of the Eye. We want friends out here, and we say so plainly.
close: Share back when you can. Ombe.
From the round shore, warmly. Write soon?
finding: We found this, and we want to share it: {part}
{part} What do you make of it?
We would rather you know this than not: {part}
sighting: We saw this, and we think you should know: {part}
From our arrays out on the ice: {part}
{part} How does it look from where you are?
archive: {part} Ours to share, so now it is yours too.
We would rather share it than keep it: {part}
culture: Something about us, so you know who you are talking to: {part}
{part} That is us. What are you like?
From the shore of the Eye: {part}
We carry warmth out onto the ice. That is who we are. {part}
We tell you about us, and you tell us about you? {part}
request: {part} We will share the same with you.
Will you share this with us? {part}
We are curious, and we will not pretend otherwise: {part}
verdict: {part} And our reasons are yours to hear.
We talked it over around the Eye. {part}
{part} Does that sit well with you?
accord: Shared, between the round shore and the Little Sun: {part}
Between us, out in the open: {part}
We share the Eye among ourselves. Now, between us and you: {part}
